action_items: Pre-existing (from iter_9/10/11, still present): React 'Encountered two children with the same key cc61c833-24f8-4036-80d7-9db405ad4386' warning fires repeatedly in /cs CSWorkbench on each poll tick. Dedupe sessions/messages by id before setState.
critical_code_review_comments: handover_sessions picks target via pick_online_agent inside loop, which uses current assigned_count — this provides a weighted round-robin across the moved sessions (good). Breaks early if no target to avoid tight loop (correct).

transfer_session writes handover_from/handover_at on cs_sessions and inserts a system msg with sender='agent', via='system' — matches spec exactly; also $inc unread_visitor by 1 so visitor sees the pill badge.
ensure_online_agent calls agent_auto_offline_if_stale first — guarantees heartbeat-stale agents are reclassified before lazy handover check. Correct ordering.
admin_cs_delete_agent chooses target with `pick_online_agent OR any-other-enabled-agent` fallback — prevents orphan sessions when no agent is currently online. Good.
cs_agent_qr_update/delete have NO created_by filter — matches new requirement that agents may edit/delete any library item (including admin-created).
cs_agent_set_status only triggers handover_sessions when going online->offline (gated on `changed and not data.online`) — avoids spurious moves on repeated offline calls.

Potential race: between agent_auto_offline_if_stale's update_one (filter online:True) and the status log insert — update_one is atomic so if two concurrent requests race, only one wins and logs. Acceptable.

Minor: assign_cs_agent falls back to ALL enabled agents when none online (including just-logged-out ones). Resulting session may be assigned to offline agent then lazy-handed-over on first visitor message. Correct, by design.
